title: Give the visual check a home, or stop claiming it
ask: tools/test_visuals.tscn is named in CLAUDE.md's command list and is in no CI workflow and no runnable job in HQ. Work out whether it is a release gate or a developer's tool, and give it a home either way: a headless renderer in CI, or a button on the Engineering page that a person presses before a tag. A check our own docs claim and nothing runs is worse than one we never claimed.
first_action: Run tools/test_visuals.tscn against tools/baseline.png, see what it actually needs, and say which home it should have.
